context: Evaluates correct implementation of the periodic metrics collection endpoint from open-nof1.ai. The solution must implement JWT authentication against CRON_SECRET_KEY, collect account performance using getAccountInformationAndPerformance, upsert a Metrics record via Prisma, and apply uniform sampling to maintain a maximum of 100 data points.

checklist.name: JWT authentication
checklist.description: The endpoint verifies the Authorization bearer token using jsonwebtoken's verify function with CRON_SECRET_KEY and returns 401 with { message: 'Unauthorized' } for invalid tokens

checklist.name: Account metrics fetch
checklist.description: The endpoint calls getAccountInformationAndPerformance with START_MONEY from environment variable as the initial capital parameter

checklist.name: Prisma upsert
checklist.description: The endpoint upserts a Metrics record for model 'Deepseek' and name 'Deepseek' using Prisma, appending the new snapshot to the metrics JSON array

checklist.name: 100-point limit with sampling
checklist.description: When the metrics array exceeds 100 points, uniform sampling is applied to reduce it back to 100 entries by selecting evenly distributed indices

checklist.name: Response format
checklist.description: The endpoint returns { data: { count: number }, message: string, success: true } on success
